summary: Brookfield Business Corporation filed a 6-K attaching its Q3 2026 results press release, disclosing an agreement to sell a further 20% of La Trobe Financial, following prior partial monetization that has returned roughly twice invested capital while retaining over half its original ownership. No price, buyer, premium or closing date was disclosed. Cumulative 2026 asset-sale proceeds and distributions reached approximately $1.4 billion. The release also references agreed acquisition of Reliance Worldwide plus completed purchases of World Freight Company and Gregg Distributors. Watch for definitive sale terms, buyer identity, regulatory timing and incremental proceeds allocation.
